product.title: Manhattan Adventure Sightseeing Boat Tour - from Chelsea Piers
product.description: Capture New York City’s landmarks from the water on this custom Manhattan sightseeing tour designed for photographers and tourists, departing from Midtown. Sail past famous sights such as the Statue of Liberty, the Brooklyn Bridge, and the Manhattan skyline, with plenty of stops for perfect photo opportunities. Enjoy expert narration from the captain as you explore the Hudson River and New York Harbor from unique vantage points.
highlights: Take in skyline views from the Hudson, East River, and Upper Bay
Sail past landmarks: Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island, and Freedom Tower
Cruise under the Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges for photo stops
Get waterfront views of Little Island, Hudson Yards, and Governors Island

start.description: New York Media Boat / Adventure Sightseeing Tours, 59 Chelsea Piers, New York, NY 10281, USA. CHELSEA PIERS / PIER 59 -- MIDTOWN. We will meet you by the dock booth on the left/south side of the golf center at CHELSEA PIERS MARINA at Pier 59. The entrance to the marina is on 11th Ave (West Side Highway) across from W17th Street.

end.description: This activity ends back at the meeting point.

product.itinerarySummary: Experience New York City from a new vantage point on an exclusive 12-person media boat tour, traditionally used by news photographers. Departing from Chelsea Piers Marina, your journey navigates the Hudson River under the guidance of a U.S. Coast Guard licensed captain. This intimate tour offers unparalleled views of downtown and midtown Manhattan with iconic landmarks and skyline vistas from the water.
